name: poly-load-sidecar
description: After the pattern file is read and closed, load the poly sidecar 'polyA' straight into CCM 0x1000B530 + track*0x880. Zeroes the 2176-byte track buffer before and after a failed/short read, requires track<3, and accepts data only when f_read reports exactly 2176 bytes. Hook 0x0801CD96 (after f_close) -> cave 0x08047C00.
